Dialogs.Dialog: Hmm... Guess hanging out with Rinko is boring, huh.
Then Rinko'll just clam up too.
So quiet... Going through some teenage angst？
In a bad mood？ ...Doesn't look like it.
Wait, are you not feeling well？
Aren't you going to do the usual？
Hey...？ Can I come a little closer？
Hey... I mean, I don't mind？
Hey... Are you thinking about holding hands？
Couples hold hands and stuff, right？ Normally...
You know...？ Rinko's hand seems lonely.
When I'm in the mood, okay？
Do Rinko and you really look like a couple...？
Like this, anyone can tell we're a couple.
My hand's not the only thing that's warm, you know？
Oh... No. Never mind, it's nothing.
People with cold hands have warm hearts, you know.
So Rinko's heart is cold, then？
Honestly, I want to be more honest...
Ah！ No letting go of my hand！
Walking side by side like this is nice. It feels like Rinko's spot.
My hand might be getting sweaty.
...Rinko and you really are a couple, huh.
Do you mind the girl being the one to hold hands...？
Not at all！ I'm actually happy about it.
Right？ I figured, so I held yours.
Lacing our fingers like this is nice.
Well, a catchy love song isn't so bad once in a while. Only at times like this, though.
Are you happy when Rinko asks to hold hands？
I see, same here... Next time, it's your turn.
What if our hands got stuck like this and we couldn't let go？
...Baths might be kind of a problem.
Y-You idiot！ That's the first thing you think of, you perv overlord！
Do we look like a couple？
Then don't we look like a married couple？
Hehe... Five years... Then don't let go till then, okay？
So, how many girls have you held hands with like this？
Let's see... Ten or so？ No, maybe more...？
There was the girl next door, my cousin... and um, also...
Oh, wow... Quite the ladies' man, huh.
Why do couples hold hands？ It's not like they'd get lost going home alone.
Then why do you hold hands, ▲小早川＊▲？
You know... I'm a little worried.
You're grinning. So I wondered if Rinko's making that face too.
I'm not holding your hand anymore...
Next time, don't you dare forget, okay？
Every time we pass that house, I look at it. It must cost a fortune.
Yeah. The garden's kept nice, too. It's a great house.
But just the upkeep must be tough. Takes money and work. Sounds like a pain.
But living there together would be nice. If it's your own place, the upkeep wouldn't be a chore, right？
Maybe... Wait, since when are we living together... Geez...
Yeah. But owning a home sounds tough these days.
Huh. So you dream of having your own house？
Of course. A love nest, as they say. We'd plan it together, help design it, live there... and somewhere along the way, we'd be three.
...Um, future plans like that, Rinko doesn't really get...
The fancy condo... That Western-looking building？ You look at it every time we pass. Interested？
No, no. Places like that probably don't care if they're livable. It's more like art. I just look.
Is that so？ I'd like to try living somewhere that cool, though.
Oh, yeah？ Well, if you're living there alone, I won't stop you...
Huh？ It still hasn't gone under.
No, I mean that run-down apartment. They've been looking for tenants forever.
These days that might be rare. Going to the bathhouse together, huddling close... It's got that vibe.
You're dreaming. Besides, you can do that kind of thing anywhere.
That house with the broken window... Does anyone still live there？
Who knows？ Most likely the family moved out, or the last person living there passed away.
Houses left behind like that are so lonely...
...It's okay. Nothing like that will happen around us.
Oh, over there... On the wall. Some birds...
Yeah, they're snuggled up. Probably the couple of the month.
Oh yeah？ Then can I ask about the human world's couple of the month？
Crows, huh... So many in one spot is kind of creepy.
It's a city. Of course there are crows. Rinko sees them sometimes on her own.
...Still... It's a bad vibe. Let's get out of here.
Fine... Just don't run ahead without me.
Oh, a cat. ...Yep, that was a real looker of a cat.
You know, like people say pretty girls or handsome guys. That cat had a nice, sharp face.
All cats look the same to me.
If you can't tell cats apart, talking with Rinko's gonna be hard, you know？
Oh, a dog. Look, by that front door.
A Doberman. It's on a chain, so it's fine.
It's scary, but it'd be cool to have one. We live in an apartment, though...
Anyway. I don't want it barking at us, so let's hurry.
So you're going to sneak a hand-hold in the confusion. Hmm.
Hey, look... Someone's walking a meerkat...
Who knows？ They seem kind of feisty, so maybe they need to blow off stress outside？
I see. Then I should walk you like this too, so you don't get stressed.
Nothing. A cloud that looked like you just fell apart.
A cloud that looked like me... You were watching that？
I don't believe in omens, but if you vanish on Rinko out of nowhere, I'll be mad, okay？
A shooting star？ No way, not at this hour.
Yeah. I didn't get to make a wish, but I saw something kind of nice.
Smell？ No, I don't smell anything.
Um... doesn't it look like it's gonna rain？
Yeah, right？ Did you bring an umbrella？
No. We'd better move before it starts.
Over there. A junior high couple. They're holding hands.
Cute. Want to hold hands too so we don't lose？
That's not why I said it. But Rinko back then could never have imagined Rinko now.
Oh, that old couple over there is holding hands...
I see. Age doesn't really matter, huh.
Yeah. Getting old doesn't change how you feel.
Seniors in life, for sure. Good to learn from.
Huh？ Were you just across the street？
...I've been right next to you the whole time.
Right. There was someone who looked just like you.
Just a lookalike. Don't say creepy stuff.
But maybe... YOU'RE the fake one？
Whoa, there's a girl with a great figure.
Don't react to every little thing. You only need to look at me.
But it means there was a girl ▲小早川＊▲ couldn't help watching, right？
Yeah, but you've got someone more important to look at. Figure it out.
Whoa, she almost ran into me.
Why's that girl in such a hurry？
Going to meet a friend or something？ She looked like a grade-schooler.
Hey, hey, did you see？ That yellow bike was so cute！
The one that just went by？ That design would fit right in on some cobblestone street in Europe.
Staring at me won't help. That's a brand name. It's gotta be expensive.
I see... I kind of want one, though.
Oh, that motorcycle's the one from that CD cover...
That's a famous foreign brand. Pretty expensive.
Hmm. It's got a different vibe from Japanese ones.
Interested？ Then I'll save the back seat just for ▲小早川＊▲.
Say that after you get your license.
Look, a car's coming. Move over to the side.
Anyway, don't you think big cars are more convenient？
Are they？ For gas, insurance, and driving, I think smaller's easier.
But a big one fits the whole family. If we're getting one, I'd want to use it like that.
Look. A fancy car's parked there. Rinko doesn't get it, but... do you want to drive one of those？
It's not really me, but as a guy, I kind of dream of it.
I see. But Rinko doesn't care if it's fancy, as long as the whole family fits.
Got it. I'll remember that for someday.
Yeah. And then Rinko gets the passenger seat, of course.
...Rinko doesn't like thinking about being sick or hurt.
Staying healthy forever is best, but you never know what'll happen.
Be careful, okay？ If you end up in the hospital, Rinko might not be a devoted nurse, you know？
Did an alien just walk past there？
An alien？ What, like a movie shoot？
I don't know. But it walked right through the wall...
I'm not. Anyway, don't leave my side！
Did a lion just walk by...？
But that definitely wasn't a costume or a stuffed toy！
If it were real, people would be chasing it or screaming, right？
True, but... If it comes to it, you're my shield, okay？
A tortoise？ Like, with a shell？
Yeah. Um, maybe a giant tortoise. And it ran by really fast.
No way. Besides, nobody else seems to care.
It was there！ Ugh. What do I do if I see it again...
You didn't see it!? A cockroach the size of a car just ran by!?
Hahaha. There's no such thing as a cockroach that big.
There was！ If it comes back, you'd better protect me！
(What on earth did she mistake for that？)
Ah... That was... No... couldn't be...
You probably wouldn't know, but there was someone who looked like a foreign musician...
No, there's no way he'd be here... Hmm.
